idea-plugin.name: AI Chat Notifications
idea-plugin.description: AI Chat Notifications Plugin helps you avoid missing AI agent prompts while you are away from the IDE. Start a task with an AI coding agent, minimize IDE, or switch to another app. When the agent needs approval, input, or another decision, the plugin sends a desktop notification so you can unlock the further work.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Show a native IDE notification when an agent needs attention in a background project window.
  • Add an Open action to focus the project window that needs attention.
